rows.value: NoVA on cars (CO2 – 91 g) / 5 % in 2026, at most 80%, plus EUR 80 per g above 155 g, minus EUR 350; monthly engine-related insurance tax by kW and CO2 (combustion) or kW and weight (electric). Paid by buyers of new vehicles (NoVA); vehicle keepers through the motor liability insurer. NoVAG 1991; Versicherungssteuergesetz (engine-related insurance tax).

rows.label: CO2 pricing: national emissions certificate trading (NEHG 2022) (Nationaler Emissionszertifikatehandel) [national]
rows.value: fixed price EUR 55 per tonne of CO2 in 2025 to 2027; EU ETS 2 market phase from 2028. Paid by fuel distributors (passed on in fuel prices). Nationales Emissionszertifikatehandelsgesetz 2022 (NEHG 2022).

rows.label: Tourist tax: local overnight levy (Ortstaxe / Nächtigungsabgabe) [regional]
rows.value: set by each Land; Vienna 5% of the accommodation price from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 (3.2% before, 8% from 1 July 2027). Paid by overnight guests (collected by the accommodation provider). Länder tourism laws (e.g. Wiener Tourismusförderungsgesetz).
rows.note: Checklist item F3

source.title: Stadt Wien: Ortstaxe

rows.label: Air passenger tax (Flugabgabe) [national]
rows.value: EUR 12 per departing passenger, EUR 30 for flights under 350 km. Paid by aircraft operators. Flugabgabegesetz (FlugAbgG).
rows.note: Checklist item F4; detailed table: air-passenger-tax

source.title: USP: Flugabgabe (last updated 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and traveller allowances (Zoll und Einfuhrumsatzsteuer) [EU and national]
rows.value: EU customs tariff; traveller allowance EUR 300 (EUR 430 by air); cash declaration from EUR 10,000; EUR 3 flat duty per item on distance-sale consignments up to EUR 150 from 1 July 2026. Paid by importers and travellers. EU customs law; Regulation (EU) 2026/382; EU cash controls.
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs

source.title: BMF: Zoll, Einreise aus Nicht-EU-Staaten, Freimengen und Freigrenze

rows.label: Stamp duties on documents and legal transactions (Gebühren) [national]
rows.value: fixed fees for applications and official documents (e.g. EUR 13 or 21 per application, EUR 112 passport); 1% on non-residential leases, 2% on easements and life annuities, 5% on bets. Paid by applicants and contracting parties. Gebührengesetz 1957 §§ 14 and 33.

rows.value: no branch profits tax (branches pay 23% corporate tax); 27.5% KESt on dividends (23% may be withheld for company shareholders). Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company). KStG 1988 §§ 21 and 22; EStG 1988 §§ 27a and 93.
